scores.evidence: Every screen at both widths shows a structural element: steps with expected results, prompt cards with highlighted fill-in fields, the MoSCoW callout, the practice-flow diagram, the practice-checklist and the quizzes. textOnlyScreens is empty for desktop-jp, mobile-jp and desktop-en. The 4-node flowchart TD (practice-flow) is readable at 390 px (mobile-jp-11/12). Its labels are Japanese in JP (desktop-jp-07/08) and English in EN (desktop-en-08), and it has a Figure 1 caption and a 図の説明を読む link.

There are no walls of text. The longest prose run is the three short paragraphs of practice-task (mobile-jp-03, desktop-jp-02), and a steps block follows them right away. Desktop JP has a median of 36 chars per line (target 30–40) and desktop EN has 69 (target 60–75). The page alternates steps, prompt, quiz and checklist through to the summary (desktop-jp-11, mobile-jp-16/17).

pq1 (mobile-jp-06, desktop-jp-04, desktop-en-04), pq2 (mobile-jp-13, desktop-jp-09, desktop-en-10) and the three check-quiz questions (mobile-jp-14..16, desktop-jp-09..11, desktop-en-10/11) are fully localized. JP shows no stray English beyond Must/Should/Could/Won't and MoSCoW, and EN shows no leftover Japanese. Nothing is clipped, and the 答える buttons sit clear of the mobile bottom bar once the page scrolls (mobile-jp-07, mobile-jp-14, mobile-jp-16). metrics.json shows no overflowX, console, mermaid, unknown-block or broken-image errors.

niceToHave: Not visible in the captures: feedback and explanation text for pq1, pq2 and check-quiz. The screenshots show only the unanswered state. An answered-state capture would cover them.
practice-flow: on desktop the 4-node TD diagram sits in a wide card that is mostly empty (desktop-jp-07/08, desktop-en-08). Keep TD for mobile.
reader: on mobile the flashcard hint says 「クリックまたはスペースキーでめくる」 (mobile-jp-18). A touch device should get a tap hint instead.
reader: on desktop the right column is empty beside the long quiz screens (desktop-jp-10/11).
summary: lessonHash is left out because I was not given it and have no shell to run review-scope.mjs --hash or --since dcb3095. For the same reason I could not get the verifies line or the changed list, or read c961471:…visual-qa.review.json through git. I used the working-tree copy only as a reference. It has an empty mustFix, so nothing needed resolving. Instead of a verify round I did a full check of every mobile-jp and desktop-jp screen and of the desktop-en screens that hold the figure and the questions. The author should re-run this review with the hash and scope, because check-review.mjs will refuse it without lessonHash. The published lesson renders cleanly in all three captures. There are no hard failures, no text-only screens, and line lengths are within target, so there are no must-fix items.
